title: Offer to hold one key of the upgrade multisig
statement:
Test USDC, no monetary value.

Open the Key holder request issue (.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/key_holder.md) on drexthealpha/Knos with your public key, a name or handle, and how to reach you. An offer is counted as an offer; a key is held only once it is seated.
evidence: an issue your account opened on drexthealpha/Knos from the key holder template, naming a Solana public key
counted_when: the account that did it is not one of Knos's own (scripts/own_github_ids.json); shown as "on tasks Knos funded itself"
